WITH race_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    raceId,
    AVG(points) as avg_points,
    AVG(wins) as avg_wins
  FROM driverStandings
  GROUP BY raceId
),
overall_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(avg_wins) as overall_avg_wins
  FROM race_groups
  WHERE avg_wins IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  rg.raceId,
  rg.avg_points,
  rg.avg_wins,
  rg.avg_wins - os.overall_avg_wins as wins_diff
FROM race_groups rg
CROSS JOIN overall_stats os
WHERE rg.avg_wins IS NOT NULL
  AND os.overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
  CASE WHEN wins_diff IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  wins_diff DESC
LIMIT 10
